        """Insert one or more columns at the given column position.

        Examples
        ========

        >>> from sympy import zeros, ones
        >>> M = zeros(3)
        >>> V = ones(3, 1)
        >>> M.col_insert(1, V)

        [0, 1, 0, 0],
        [0, 1, 0, 0],
        [0, 1, 0, 0]])

        col
        row_insert
        """
        # Allows you to build a matrix even if it is null matrix
        if not self:
            return type(self)(other)

        pos = as_int(pos)

            pos = self.cols + pos
        if pos < 0:
